prompt.alinti: Someone just open-sourced a GitHub repo that lets you run Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra to 10x your work. It's a free skill called Claudex, and all you need to do is just drop it inside your Claudex or Codex, and it will automatically route everything to Fable 5 and Astra 6. Fable 5.1 writes the plan, and GPT-6 Astra audits it, and they go back and forth until they agree. Then they swap roles. GPT-6 builds it, and Fable 5 audits it. So instead of one model auditing its own code, you get a second opinion from the smartest model on the planet.
Comment SPLIT, and I'll send you a link to the skill.

yontem.ne: İki modelin (Fable 5.1 ve GPT-6 Astra) işbirliğiyle kod yazım ve denetimi için otomatik bir çerçeve sağlayan açık kaynaklı bir araç.
yontem.alinti: Someone just open-sourced a skill that makes Claude and Codex argue about your code before a single line ships. It’s called Claudex Loop. Drop it into Claude Code or Codex and it routes the work to two models: Fable 5.1 writes the plan, GPT-6 Astra audits it — findings, not vibes. They go back and forth (max 5 rounds) until it’s APPROVED. Then they swap: GPT-6 builds, Fable 5 inspects the diff in a fresh session.
